instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a sunny outdoor park with green grass and blurred trees, the bald man in the dark blue t-shirt (R1) on the left and the woman with a ponytail in the dark blue t-shirt (R2) on the right crouch in a line, pulling a thick yellow rope. The bald man (R1) pulls with a focused, open-mouthed expression, while the woman (R2) stands behind him, pulling with a straining grimace. Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene with warm tones, soft shadows, and a shallow depth of field.
elements: R1 is the front person in the rope-pulling line while R2 is behind him
R2 pulls the rope from behind R1 rather than leading the line
R1 and R2 both pull the same thick yellow rope

the scene is a sunny outdoor park with green grass and blurred trees
